status: Exploratory specification recorded before this estimator-comparison run, after earlier signal-research results were examined. No reserved-test evaluation or automatic selection.
target: One-month decimal total return: enter the next trading-day close after the decision and exit the following rebalance close.
core_feature_rationale: Additive long-history macro/risk inputs. Sparse policy fields are excluded for every model; existing four-interaction wider-input Ridge remains a separate signal-research experiment.
lag_definition: Asset lags are the calendar-month returns ending at the current decision close, already known when forecasting the next holding interval. Macro lags are the previous decision month's growth/inflation surprises. Never shift forward holding-period targets into predictors.
eligibility: All six methods use the same eligible training rows and common forecast/evaluation dates, requiring complete core, lag and interaction inputs. Historical mean uses identical completed target rows but ignores predictor values.

preprocessing.target_standardization: Training mean/std per asset, inverted before metrics and BL; targets never clipped. All feature clipping, imputation and scaling are fit inside each inner and outer training fold.

ridge_objective: Mean squared-error objective with 0.5*alpha*L2 penalty; scikit-learn Ridge receives n_train*alpha.
tuning: Per-asset chronological inner validation. Each inner training target must end by its validation decision. Only validation outcomes completed by the outer decision are scored. Minimize mean decimal-return squared error over all eligible inner folds; fixed parameter order breaks ties.
oos_r2: 1 - sum((actual-model_forecast)^2)/sum((actual-expanding_mean_forecast)^2), on identical dates per asset; not sklearn's test-mean R2.
portfolio: Reuse Signal Research monthly_allocation, empirical per-model forecast-error variance, monthly covariance, BL tau 0.05/risk aversion 2.5, bounds, grid, drift and 5bp per dollar traded. Portfolio state runs continuously; all models use identical dates.
stability_threshold: Flag |raw monthly forecast| > 20% for inspection; no predicted-return cap or post-hoc suppression.

stages.combined_extension: deferred until separate checks have been reviewed
stages.bvar: Optional and not implemented in this iteration; a one-lag joint system would need its own small-variable specification and matched lag information.
